description: Source code implementing the behavior and validation strategies for CustomResources in Kubernetes API extensions, including schema validation, field selection, and update handling.

classes.name: customResourceStrategy
classes.description: Implements behavior for CustomResources, including validation, preparation for create/update, and field selection.

classes.name: selectableField
classes.description: Represents a selectable field with its name, JSONPath, and potential error.

methods.name: NewStrategy
methods.description: Creates a new customResourceStrategy with provided parameters, including optional field selector setup.

methods.name: prepareSelectableFields
methods.description: Prepares a list of selectableField objects from v1.SelectableField definitions, parsing JSONPath expressions.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Returns whether the resource is namespace scoped.

methods.name: GetResetFields
methods.description: Returns fields that are reset and should not be modified by users.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Clears status and sets initial generation before creating a new resource.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Clears or preserves status fields and increments generation on update.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a new custom resource object, including schema and CEL validation.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Generates warnings during creation, e.g., finalizer validation warnings.

methods.name: generateWarningsFromObj
methods.description: Helper to generate warnings based on object finalizers.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation (no-op here).

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Indicates creation on update is not allowed.

methods.name: AllowUnconditionalUpdate
methods.description: Indicates unconditional update is not allowed.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to custom resources, including schema, list types, and CEL rules.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Generates warnings during update, e.g., finalizer warnings.

methods.name: GetAttrs
methods.description: Returns labels and fields for filtering.

methods.name: selectableFields
methods.description: Returns a set of fields for filtering, including metadata and custom fields.

methods.name: MatchCustomResourceDefinitionStorage
methods.description: Creates a storage filter predicate based on label and field selectors.
